ekr.views/authored/a-cursor-pages-a-neig.purpose: The hub's 1-hop neighbourhood pages as 250+249, 250+250 and 101+101 records at limit 250, the last with nothing remaining, and a cursor at the end answers an empty page.

ekr.views/authored/a-node-is-not-found-a.purpose: A node created at revision 1 is not found at revision 0 by describe or expand, is described at revision 1, and the overview counts it from the revision that recorded it.

ekr.views/authored/a-retracted-assertion.purpose: An assertion added at revision 1 and retracted at revision 2 is absent at 0, Active at 1, and Retracted but still projected at 2.

ekr.views/authored/a-revision-beyond-the.purpose: A store at head 0 projects revision 0 when asked for it by number, and refuses revision 1 as not found, naming the request and the head.

ekr.views/authored/a-schema-evolution-pr.purpose: After one schema change the newest projection lists two versions and version 1's ontology, and a projection at revision 0 lists one version and version 0's ontology at head 1.

ekr.views/authored/a-search-lists-at-mos.purpose: A search matching 600 nodes answers 100 at limit 100 and 1 at limit 1, reporting all 600, and refuses a limit of 101 or 0.

ekr.views/authored/a-search-with-no-matc.purpose: A text in no name or alias answers no match; a text found only after lowercasing answers Folded matches; an Exact alias match of degree 1 comes before a Folded name match of degree 600.

ekr.views/authored/a-seed-only-store-pro.purpose: A store holding only its seed projects revision 0 at head 0, with one schema version, one revision entry and no transaction id.

ekr.views/authored/an-assertion-about-an.purpose: The one assertion whose subject is an edge is projected under that edge.

ekr.views/authored/an-expansion-refuses-.purpose: Depth 0 and 2, limit 2,000 and edge_limit 5,000 are answered; depth 3 or -1, limit 2,001 or 0, edge_limit 5,001 or 0 and a negative cursor are refused, naming the first broken input.

ekr.views/authored/an-overview-lists-at-.purpose: The overview lists 300 top nodes by default, 500 and 1 at the bounds, and refuses a limit of 501 or 0.

ekr.views/authored/an-unknown-seed-is-re.purpose: An expansion with one unknown seed among known ones is refused naming it, two unknown seeds name the first given, and describing an unknown node is refused naming it.

ekr.views/authored/seeded-evidence-is-pr.purpose: All three evidence records a seed admits are projected, and all three as retained.

ekr.views/authored/the-edge-limit-cuts-a.purpose: At edge_limit 100 the hub's neighbourhood pages as 102 nodes and 100 edges, then 100 and 100 starting with the edge the first page's last node closes.

ekr.views/authored/the-overview-derives-.purpose: The better-linked of two event types is the observation type, and the buckets turn from days to Monday weeks past a 120-day span.
